title: sessions
description: Mode B session manifest: one recording session per entry (camera file + optional screen file + its Whisper word JSON). The input of scripts/rough_cut.py and the eval script; paths may point at files that are not on this machine (missing media is a warning).

sessions.description: sessions in timeline order; rough_cut.py keeps this order in edit.json

camera.description: camera file path; the session's Whisper word JSON is in its time base

screen.description: optional screen recording of the same session (OBS writes it as a separate file starting a second or two apart)

words.description: Whisper word JSON for the session: segments[].words[] with word/start/end

sync_offset_s.description: seconds to add to a camera time to get the screen time; computed from the file name timestamps plus the container start time when omitted
